note: Deduplicated to one record per (file, base, source, queried) cluster. Among answers matching NEITHER base nor source: does the emitted value belong to a country in the reference (source/installed) country's UN M49 subregion/continent more often than a uniformly drawn other value would? 'other' = the base country. Values shared by several countries (EUR, Spanish) count as a hit if ANY owner is in the region; the null applies the same rule. z is a Poisson-binomial z.
